Warszawice  (local name Warszewice) is a village in Gmina Sobienie-Jeziory, Otwock County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland. The village covers an area of . The population was near 330. In the village is Voivodship Road 805, school and church. From 1975 to 1998 village was in Siedlce Voivodeship. It lies approximately  north of Sobienie-Jeziory,  south of Otwock, and  south-east of Warsaw.

Radwanków Szlachecki, Warszówka, Całowanie, Dziecinów.
